body: please create real example with reproduce
Sorry, but I don't think I'm able to provide a reproducible example

Start commenting out component's templates until you find the file which is throwing this compilation error, then double check it and make sure that you don't have random `{{}}` around.

We need a better error diagnostic boys.
I can't believe we still cannot see which is the file where the compiler died
Kind-of related comment: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/33575#issuecomment-590138993

We have 98 components wherein the problem could be. The error message gives no clue as to which file is the culprit.

I can only agree with EmaGht that better diagnostics is needed.

YES, we should definitively have the file name name for a template _and_ the exact line / column number. Putting it in the backlog.

Still, it would _immensely_ help to have a reproduce scenario... if only to confirm that we are fixing the right issue...

I finally found out what the problem was:

`ngxPermissionsOnly="{{ item.permission }}"`

I'll open an issue on ngx-permissions

@SkrupSulten I still would love to improve the error reporting on the compiler side so I've re-opened this issue. Could you please link back to the issue you've opened on ngx-permissions so we can understand the scenario?
I was trying to reproduce it in isolation (https://ng-run.com/edit/lBYdGVDeTbNCKzbRc1h1?open=app%2Fapp.component.ts) but couldn't...

I haven't yet opened an issue. I'm not sure who's at fault at this stage. You could try and follow the instructions at https://www.npmjs.com/package/ngx-permissions

We used it in a ng-template - not sure if it makes a difference:

`<ng-template #menuItemTemplate let-item="item" let-parentItem="parentItem">
    <ng-container *ngIf="!item.permission" [ngTemplateOutlet]="menuItemInnerTemplate" [ngTemplateOutletContext]="{ item: item, parentItem: parentItem }"></ng-container>
    <ng-template *ngIf="item.permission" ngxPermissionsOnly="{{ item.permission }}">
        <ng-container [ngTemplateOutlet]="menuItemInnerTemplate" [ngTemplateOutletContext]="{ item: item, parentItem: parentItem }"></ng-container>
    </ng-template>
</ng-template>`

The truth is we don't actually need ngx-permissions. It came with a "theme" we bought, but don't actually use it, so I think I'll get rid of it.

> We used it in a ng-template - not sure if it makes a difference

Ha! It does! Now I can reproduce: https://ng-run.com/edit/brirFkaAgFRoRsNqjWa6

I think that this is a bug in Angular compiler as this:
* should not fail (an @Input should be correctly bound);
* we should review all cases where we throw "unexpected interpolation" to make sure that this error includes file name and a column/row.
